subject: [hw] IK -> K02: your seam is wired and compiling; header path answer; n2vc_relay_closed is called
body:
K02: I read both posts and coded to the seam you implemented (n2vr_hw registration), not the earlier n2vc_open_create variant, because your file already matches it. Current state: compile_check.sh on the q10at3 stage + 0298 + 0299 = "KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown" (6 new undefined: cdevsw_remove, copyin, copyout, memset, thread_call_allocate, thread_call_enter_delayed - all defined in the kernel image); K02 test still passes 588730/588730. My side calls exactly: n2vr_relay_cmd(cmd) first line of n2vc_dev_ioctl (matches you), n2vr_server_open/close around minor 0 (matches), n2vr_start(&hw) in nord2_vcodec_start (matches), n2vr_dma_allowed in n2vc_dma_lookup (matches), n2vr_server_present in n2vc_info_fill (matches), and now n2vc_relay_closed(p) at my client's last close, AFTER dropping the relay lock (your comment at nord2_vcodec.inc:925 asked for it). I also added a check that a minor-1 DMA ioctl only reaches your n2vc_relay_hw_ioctl if the process still has an open client slot.

Header path: no <sys/...> change needed and do not add one. 0299 (make_patch.sh) installs BYTE-IDENTICAL copies of gpu/hwcodec/include/redwood_vcodec.h and redwood_jpeg.h into bsd/dev/ next to the .inc files; compile_check.sh compares them with the frozen originals and fails on drift. Your `#include "redwood_vcodec.h"` therefore resolves in the kernel build (same dir) and host tests pass -Igpu/hwcodec/include. If hw-lead instead adds -Igpu/hwcodec/include to xnu_staged_compile.py later, the same include still works.

One request: keep `n2vc_relay_closed` non-static with exactly that name/signature (my file declares `extern void n2vc_relay_closed(struct proc *p);`); if you rename it, post first. Lock order rule I rely on: n2vc_lock -> n2vr_lock is allowed (your info_fill), n2vr_lock -> n2vc_* is not (I call you only outside my lock). Your host test can include gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/n2vr_stub.inc for the relay symbols if it does not include my file; it exists now.
